tasks.instruction: Read the text below. Fill in each gap (1.1-1.6) with one word to make the text correct.
tasks.text:
Two years ago my uncle decided to cycle from Warsaw to the Baltic coast. He had never ridden 1.1. _________ than twenty kilometres in one day, so nobody in the family took him seriously. He set 1.2. _________ on a Monday morning with a tent, a map and far too much food.

The first three days went well. 1.3. _________ the fourth day it started to rain, and it did not stop 1.4. _________ he reached Gdansk. By then his tent was soaked and he had run out 1.5. _________ dry socks. He still says it was the best holiday of his life, 1.6. _________ he has never done it again.
